notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
1) Added a new beautiful beaver sprite
2) Secret underground levels of fast transitions
3) Some invisible secrets in the levels
4) Added and changed background houses

notes.title: Upcoming update and fixes
notes.content:
I'm checking the entire game just in case and adding "forced transitions" between levels everywhere to prevent impassable areas.

Also, the beaver will get a new appearance that better matches his species.

"Quick transition" levels and mini-secrets are being added. Also, invisible blocks and objects are being placed throughout the game, it will be nice to find them!

Until next time!

notes.title: BOBR SPRINT update
notes.content: [b]Hi[/b]! A major update has been released: levels have been improved, new tilesets have been added, some of the graphics have been reworked, and the music has been replaced by a more dynamic one with several new songs. The game's design has also been completely revamped.
